subject.title: fix(matrix): reverse-proxy path support for Matrix homeserver URLs

question: Should OpenClaw formally support a path component in `channels.matrix.homeserver` so custom Matrix transport requests resolve beneath that path rather than at the URL origin?
rationale: The patch is narrow and source-consistent, but it changes compatibility-sensitive semantics of an existing channel configuration value for reverse-proxy deployments.

options.title: Support path-qualified homeservers
options.body: Approve the PR direction, refresh it onto current main, and treat the configured homeserver path as part of the Matrix API base URL.

options.title: Keep origin-root semantics
options.body: Retain the existing root-only homeserver interpretation and close this PR unless a separately designed Matrix proxy/base-path configuration contract is approved.

recommendation.title: Support path-qualified homeservers
recommendation.body: Approve the PR direction, refresh it onto current main, and treat the configured homeserver path as part of the Matrix API base URL.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the clearest Matrix-domain routing candidate visible in the supplied review history.
